*3Q26 Sales of $431 million, up 15% versus prior year*


*3Q26 Earnings Per Share of ($0.28); Adjusted Earnings Per Share of ($0.24)*


*3Q26 Cash Flow from Operations of $48 million, up $21 million versus prior year*


*Project CENTURY Selected for $47 million FIELDS Grant to Support Ammonia Platform Investment*


**


**Parsippany, N.J., November 4, 2026** – AdvanSix **(NYSE: ASIX)** , a vertically integrated chemistry company serving diverse end markets, today announced its financial results for the third quarter ending September 30, 2026.


**Third Quarter 2026 Summary**


“Our third quarter results reflect strong commercial execution and the resilience of our integrated business model as we navigate significant input cost inflation and a dynamic market environment,” said Erin Kane, president and CEO of AdvanSix. “We generated 15% sales growth year-over-year as our teams continued to leverage both formula and market-based pricing mechanisms to offset inflationary raw material costs. While our core caprolactam operating rate continues to exceed global industry averages, reduced production output drove unfavorable fixed cost absorption in the quarter. We are taking decisive actions to enhance cash generation, improve our cost position, and optimize our portfolio while continuing to prudently invest for attractive long-term growth opportunities. We remain focused on executing our strategic priorities and positioning AdvanSix to deliver sustainable long-term value.”

Sales of $431 million in the quarter increased approximately 15% versus the prior year driven by 17% favorable pricing, partially offset by a 2% decline in volume. Raw material pass-through pricing was up 10% following a net cost increase in benzene and propylene (inputs to cumene which is a key feedstock to our products). Market-based pricing improved by 7% primarily reflecting an increase across all product lines and strong commercial execution amid a higher input cost environment. Lower sales volume was primarily driven by lower caprolactam sales.

Adjusted EBITDA of $14.6 million in the quarter decreased $10.1 million versus the prior year primarily driven by the unfavorable impact of reduced production output and higher raw material costs, partially offset by higher pricing and disciplined cost savings including our non-manpower fixed cost savings initiative.


Adjusted earnings per share of ($0.24) decreased $0.32 versus the prior year driven primarily by the factors discussed above.


Cash flow from operations of $48.0 million in the quarter increased $21.4 million versus the prior year primarily due to disciplined working capital performance. Capital expenditures of $18.3 million in the quarter decreased $8.2 million versus the prior year, as expected, driven by continued risk-based prioritization of base investments and progression of growth projects including SUSTAIN.


******


**Credit Agreement**


On August 14, 2026, the Company completed a refinancing of its existing credit facility by entering into a new 5-year $425 million credit facility providing ample liquidity and capital deployment optionality. The new agreement is comprised of a $275 million senior secured revolving credit facility and a $150 million senior secured term loan facility.


**Outlook**


- Expect tighter ammonium sulfate supply and demand dynamics into 2027 amid challenged sulfur input cost environment
- Acetone spread over propylene costs expected to hold near cycle averages
- Continue to optimize Nylon Solutions price over raws spreads and sales volume mix in soft industrial end market environment
- Now expect Capital Expenditures of approximately $90 million in 2026 versus $116 million in 2025, reflecting risk-based prioritization of base investments and enterprise programs with continued progression of growth programs including SUSTAIN
- Continue to expect pre-tax income impact of plant turnarounds to be approximately $17 million in 2026 versus $25 million in 2025
- Continue to expect 2H 2026 sequential cash flow improvement primarily due to a reduced Capital Expenditures run-rate, working capital tailwinds including our 4Q 2026 pre-buy program in Plant Nutrients, and timing of annual payments paid in 1H 2026


******


“Looking ahead, we remain focused on navigating near-term market dynamics while strengthening our performance and positioning AdvanSix for the future. We are prioritizing disciplined cost management, cash generation and capital deployment while advancing our strategic growth initiatives. We will ensure a well-managed balance sheet as we continue to progress evaluation of our potential DEF growth project as well as Project CENTURY. In addition, our non-manpower fixed cost savings program remains on track while we continue to anticipate 45Q carbon capture tax credits to support improved earnings and cash flow generation moving forward,” concluded Kane.


**Dividend**


The Company’s Board of Directors declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.16 per share on the Company’s common stock. The dividend is payable on December 1, 2026 to stockholders of record as of the close of business on November 17, 2026.

**About AdvanSix**


AdvanSix is a vertically integrated chemistry company that produces essential materials for our customers across diverse end markets. Our value chain of our five U.S.-based manufacturing facilities plays a critical role in global supply chains and enables us to innovate and deliver essential products for our customers across building and construction, fertilizers, agrochemicals, plastics, solvents, packaging, paints, coatings, adhesives, electronics and other end markets. Guided by our core values of Safety, Integrity, Accountability and Respect, AdvanSix strives to deliver best-in-class customer experiences and differentiated products in the industries of nylon solutions, plant nutrients, and chemical intermediates. More information on AdvanSix can be found at http://www.advansix.com.
